description: Create an artboard: new at a position and size (Layer > New > Artboard), from layers (Artboard from Layers), from a group (Artboard from Group), or a new document of type Artboard (File > New). The steps in the document form one history state

target.description: layers: the layers to put on the artboard. group: the group to convert

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

x.description: new: left edge in pixels. Default to the right of the existing artboards

y.description: new: top edge in pixels. Default 0

name: create_artboard
title: Create Artboard
